name: filter-bar
title: Filter bar
description: A row of filter fields that grow to fill the width, with the search and reset actions at the end. Wraps on narrow screens.
whenToUse: Above a table or list. Inside a card it sits flush with a hairline under it.

variants.description: The fields; each tx-field inside grows from 160px.

a11y: Wrap in <form role="search"> when it filters results.
